ko.slowmo.desc: KO slow-motion speed (1 = normal). Visual only; the match is already over.

ko.dropMs.desc: Drop KO (jab, chip, any sour hit): real ms for the fall.

ko.flyMs.desc: Fly KO (sweet Cross/Hook, any Uppercut): real ms of flight to the ropes.

ko.sitMs.desc: Fly KO: real ms to slump into the sitting pose after reaching the ropes.

ko.flyMaxDistance.desc: Fly KO: max px travelled (stops earlier at the ropes).

ko.resultDelayMs.desc: Pause after the KO animation before the result screen.

punches.jab.startup.desc: Jab: frames before the fist moves. Lower = faster.

punches.jab.sourEarly.desc: Jab: early-sour frames while the fist extends (jammed zone).

punches.jab.sweet.desc: Jab: sweet frames at full extension.

punches.jab.sour.desc: Jab: late-sour frames after the sweet spot.

punches.jab.recovery.desc: Jab: frames to recover after the active frames (Vulnerable).

punches.jab.whiffRecovery.desc: Jab: extra recovery frames on a miss (punish window).

punches.jab.reach.desc: Jab: distance the fist travels at full extension (px).

punches.jab.hitRadius.desc: Jab: size of the fist hitbox (px).

punches.jab.damage.desc: Jab: full damage of a clean hit.

punches.jab.staminaCost.desc: Jab: stamina the attacker spends to throw it.

punches.jab.staminaDamage.desc: Jab: stamina the defender loses when hit/blocking.

punches.jab.stunBuild.desc: Jab: stun meter added to the defender on a direct hit.

punches.jab.startReachFrac.desc: Jab: where the fist starts extending (0-1 of reach). Higher = shorter jammed zone.

punches.hook.guardChipMult.desc: Hook: share of its damage that chips through High Guard.

punches.uppercut.crossDamageMult.desc: Uppercut: damage as a multiple of the Cross damage.

hit.reducedDamageMult.desc: Reduced damage as a share of full (body hits, sour on face).

hit.attackerStaminaPenalty.desc: Stamina the attacker loses when blocked / on sour vs Normal.

hit.counterDamageMult.desc: Damage multiplier for Cross/Hook counters on the opponent's startup.

hit.sourStunMult.desc: Stun build of a sour hit, as a share of a sweet hit.

stars.max.desc: Stars needed to unlock the Uppercut.

fatigue.perUse.desc: Fatigue added each time a punch type is thrown.

fatigue.decayPerSec.desc: Fatigue that wears off per second once the decay pause has passed.

fatigue.freeUses.desc: Repeats of a punch type allowed before its fatigue bars start to fill.

guard.perfectFrames.desc: Frames after raising guard that count as a Perfect Guard.

guard.perfectCooldownFrames.desc: Guard must be down this many frames before a raise can Perfect Guard (anti-mash).

guard.staminaDrainPerSec.desc: Stamina drained per second while holding High Guard.

guard.perfectGuardStaminaGain.desc: Stamina the defender gains on a Perfect Guard.

guard.perfectGuardAttackerStunFrames.desc: Frames the attacker is staggered after hitting a Perfect Guard.

guard.perfectGuardStunBuild.desc: Stun meter added to the attacker on a Perfect Guard.

dodge.iFrames.desc: Invincible frames at the start of a dodge.

dodge.vulnerableFrames.desc: Vulnerable frames after a dodge ends.

dodge.stunnedVulnerableMult.desc: Multiplier on post-dodge Vulnerable while stunned.

dodge.neutralDeadzone.desc: Stick tilt below this dodges backwards (backstep).

body.coreRadius.desc: Core (face) radius. Hits reaching it use the full-damage row.

stun.threshold.desc: Stun meter needed to be stunned.

stun.decayPerSec.desc: Stun meter lost per second when not being hit.

stun.decayDelayFrames.desc: Frames after a hit before stun starts decaying.

stun.overflowFramesPerPoint.desc: Extra stun frames per point over the threshold.

stamina.regenIdlePerSec.desc: Regen per second with no input at all.

stamina.regenActivePerSec.desc: Regen per second while moving (not attacking).

stamina.regenDelayFrames.desc: Frames after spending stamina before regen starts.

stamina.exhaustRecoverAt.desc: After hitting 0, Vulnerable until stamina climbs back to this.

movement.minSeparation.desc: Closest the two boxers can stand (px).

input.bufferFrames.desc: Frames a press is remembered while busy (input buffer).

input.joystickDeadzone.desc: Stick tilt ignored near the centre.

match.durationSec.desc: Round length in seconds. Timeout: higher health % wins.

match.startDistance.desc: Distance between the boxers at the start of a round (px).

net.pingSamples.desc: Online: pings taken to pick the delay.

net.connectTimeoutMs.desc: Online: give up joining after this long (ms).

net.turnFetchTimeoutMs.desc: Online: max wait for TURN credentials (ms).

net.stallIndicatorMs.desc: Online: show "waiting for opponent" after a stall this long (ms). Stalls only happen past the rollback window.

training.dummyInfiniteStamina.desc: Dummy never runs out of stamina (keeps High Guard up).

dodge.buffWindowFrames.desc: After a dodge ends, a punch thrown within this many frames is powered up.

dodge.buffDamageMult.desc: Damage multiplier for that powered-up punch after a dodge.

hit.hitstopFrames.desc: Hit-stop: frames the whole fight freezes on a damaging hit (counters x2). 0 = off.

ai.reactionFrames.desc: AI: Frames before the AI reacts to what you do (lower = harder).

ai.attackRange.desc: AI: Distance at which the AI starts throwing punches (px).

ai.attackChance.desc: AI: Chance per frame to attack when in range and ready.

ai.attackCooldownFrames.desc: AI: Minimum frames between AI attacks.

ai.jabWeight.desc: AI: How often the AI picks a Jab.

ai.crossWeight.desc: AI: How often the AI picks a Cross.

ai.hookWeight.desc: AI: How often the AI picks a Hook (close range).

ai.guardChance.desc: AI: Chance the AI raises guard when it sees you start a punch.

ai.guardHoldFrames.desc: AI: How long the AI holds guard once raised.

ai.dodgeChance.desc: AI: Chance the AI dodges instead of guarding.

ai.retreatStaminaBelow.desc: AI: AI backs off when its stamina is below this.

match.introSec.desc: READY... GO! countdown before a round (seconds). Nobody can move until GO. 0 = off.

punches.jab.fatigueBars.desc: Jab: fatigue bars (max fatigue level) shown on its button.

punches.jab.fatigueSpeedPerBar.desc: Jab: startup/recovery slowdown per lit fatigue bar (0.12 = +12%).

punches.jab.fatigueDamagePerBar.desc: Jab: damage lost per lit fatigue bar (0.1 = -10%).

punches.hook.fatigueBars.desc: Hook: fatigue bars (max fatigue level) shown on its button.

punches.hook.fatigueSpeedPerBar.desc: Hook: startup/recovery slowdown per lit fatigue bar (0.12 = +12%).

punches.hook.fatigueDamagePerBar.desc: Hook: damage lost per lit fatigue bar (0.1 = -10%).

punches.cross.fatigueBars.desc: Cross: fatigue bars (max fatigue level) shown on its button.

punches.cross.fatigueSpeedPerBar.desc: Cross: startup/recovery slowdown per lit fatigue bar (0.12 = +12%).

punches.cross.fatigueDamagePerBar.desc: Cross: damage lost per lit fatigue bar (0.1 = -10%).

fatigue.decayDelayFrames.desc: Fatigue of a punch type only starts wearing off after this many frames without throwing it (repeating always builds).

net.inputDelayFrames.desc: Online: local input delay in frames (rollback hides the rest). Higher = fewer corrections, more sluggish.

net.maxRollbackFrames.desc: Online: how far behind the opponent may be before the game waits (frames). Higher = fewer freezes, bigger corrections.

hit.pushFrames.desc: Pushback: ticks the knockback is spread over (smooth slide, not a teleport).

punches.jab.pushHit.desc: Jab: px the defender is pushed back when it lands.

punches.jab.pushBlock.desc: Jab: px the defender is pushed back when it is blocked.

punches.cross.pushHit.desc: Cross: px the defender is pushed back when it lands.

punches.cross.pushBlock.desc: Cross: px the defender is pushed back when it is blocked.

punches.hook.pushHit.desc: Hook: px the defender is pushed back when it lands.

punches.hook.pushBlock.desc: Hook: px the defender is pushed back when it is blocked.

punches.uppercut.pushHit.desc: Uppercut: px the defender is pushed back when it lands.

punches.uppercut.pushBlock.desc: Uppercut: px the defender is pushed back when it is blocked. (Uppercut cannot be blocked.)

stars.counterGain.desc: Stars gained for landing a counter (a sweet non-counter hit gives 1).
